title: Mount probe
description: data of: mountprobe.py --json. Stage 1 of docs/mount-probe.md: with no pulses and no mount moves, the guide camera's star and the main camera's plate solves tracked together, as pointing in arcsec north and west; each camera's drift, the two tracks' parting (flex) and each track's scatter. With --dry-run, what it would do.

calibration_usable.description: A kept guider calibration usable at this Dec and side: needed to read the guide star's moves as north and west.

at.description: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS local, also in the raw file's name.

ra.description: Degrees, as the handset believed at the start.

parting.description: Arcsec the guide track's line parts from the main camera's over the run, north and west.

flex_threshold.description: Arcsec (one guide pixel) a parting must pass to count as flex.

raw.description: The JSON file with both tracks, (seconds, north, west) each point.
